context: Saito advises Yuki on stress and reliance.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical advice; vocabulary (世の中/性格/実感/依存/根本) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 最近、疲れが取れないんです。
lines.en: Lately I can't shake my fatigue.
lines.style: tired office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 根本の原因は、休息不足ですね。
lines.en: The root cause is lack of rest.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: カフェインに、依存してるかもしれません。
lines.en: I might be dependent on caffeine.
lines.style: honest office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 依存を、少しずつ減らしましょう。
lines.en: Let's reduce the dependence little by little.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 頑張りすぎる性格なんです。
lines.en: I have a character that overworks.
lines.style: reflective office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 性格は、無理に変えなくていいですよ。
lines.en: You don't have to force your character to change.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 休む大切さを、実感しました。
lines.en: I realized the importance of rest.
lines.style: understanding office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 世の中、急がば回れ、ですよ。
lines.en: In this world, slow and steady wins.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
